lessons: CRITICAL fabrication removed: the skill was built on KSP as a third-party-seller platform with a 'partner API for approved vendors' and 'KSP checkout/logistics' -- all FABRICATED. KSP is a first-party electronics retailer with only an affiliate program. Reframed KSP everywhere (description, Step 1/2/3, gotchas, troubleshooting, MCP, platform-guides.md section + comparison table) as a price-comparison reference only, and swapped in Yad2 (Israel's actual dominant marketplace, previously scoped OUT) as a real sell platform. Description change -> Phase 5.7 trigger swap (KSP-sell -> Yad2-sell + invoice triggers), non-regressing.

Added missing core obligations: tax invoice (חשבונית מס/קבלה) per sale, and the Israel-Invoice allocation-number (מספר הקצאה) reform with the dropping thresholds (20k 2025 / 10k Jan 2026 / 5k mid-2026). Added the consumer cancellation-fee cap (5% or NIS 100) and the 4-month extended window (disabilities/seniors/olim). Reconciled the Zap fee contradiction (comparison PPC model vs marketplace commission model). Fixed the stale Instagram URL (business.instagram.com -> facebook.com/business/instagram). Softened the 'Meta removed native checkout in 2025' framing (Israeli Shops never had native checkout -- it was US-only).

Replaced fabricated couriers (Mahirpak/ShipBob IL) with the real Israeli e-commerce couriers (HFD, Cheetah, Baldar) + named Israeli PSPs (Tranzila/Cardcom/Meshulam/Grow) for the off-platform checkout path.

Judge+Expert round 2: the KSP-partner-API fabrication SURVIVED in the HE Recommended-MCP section (and that line still grouped KSP as a marketplace + omitted Yad2) after the EN was fixed -- a fix is not done until BOTH languages match. Fixed HE MCP to mirror EN (Zap store/XML feed + Meta Graph API, no KSP API; Yad2 in the platform list). Also fixed: stale Facebook 'payment processing' line in platform-guides.md, the Zap comparison-table cell (now shows both fee models), and the Bundled-Resources descriptions (KSP->Yad2 in EN+HE).

Deferred (MAJOR, next cycle): Yad2 is integrated structurally but absent from the worked Examples and the sample analytics report (still Zap/Facebook/Instagram only) -- add a Yad2 example next cycle. Deferred: the research also suggested the skill's category (developer-tools) is a weak fit for an osek-murshe seller persona (marketing-growth / tax-and-finance fit better) and that the Python helper-scripts implied by allowed-tools don't exist -- left both for a deliberate recategorization/scripting decision.
